The instant bail applications have been filed under Section 439 Cr.P.C. on behalf of accused-petitioners.

The petitioners have been arrested in connection with FIR No.21/2024 registered at Police Station Vidhyadhar Nagar, Jaipur City (North) for the offence(s) under Sections 420 and 120-B of IPC and under Sections 66-C and 66-D of IT Act.

sentences.text: Learned counsels for the petitioners submits that the accused-petitioners have falsely been implicated in the case.
He further submits that there is no complaint against the accused- petitioners that they have cheated the customers and received goods illegally or committed any cyber crime.
The accused- petitioners are in custody since 01.08.2023.
The matter is exclusively triable by Magistrate.
Charge-sheet has already been produced in the present case.

He further submits that there are no criminal antecedents against the accused-petitioners and the trial of the case will take considerable time, therefore, the benefit of bail may be granted to the accused-petitioners.
Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor vehemently opposes the bail applications.

Considering the arguments advanced by the counsels for the parties and looking to the fact that accused-petitioners remained in custody for quite a long period commencing from 01.08.2023 to till date and the matter is exclusively triable by Magistrate and there are no criminal antecedents against the accused-petitioners, [2024:RJ-JP:17723] (3 of 3) [CRLMB-1158/2024] thus, without commenting anything on the merits of the case, I deem it just and proper to enlarge the accused-petitioners on bail.

Accordingly, the bail applications under Section 439 Cr.P.C. are allowed and it is ordered that the accused-petitioners namely;
(i) Rohit Kumar S/o Manoj Sindhi, (ii) Rahul Kumar Sindhi S/o Manoj & (iii) Abhishek Kumar S/o Shri Rajesh Roshan in connection with FIR No.21/2024 registered at Police Station Vidhyadhar Nagar, Jaipur City (North) shall be enlarged on bail provided each of them furnishes a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- with two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the learned trial Judge for their appearance before the court concerned on all the dates of hearing as and when called upon to do so.
